body:
Parent: https://github.com/Cratis/.github/issues/24

## Context

The approved one-off rewrite removed Planner and Ensemble paths from `Cratis/AI` `main`, local refs, reflogs, and ordinary remote branches. The purge is not complete on GitHub: historical pull-request refs remain advertised and old Planner/Ensemble commits can still be fetched through them.

A full pre-rewrite bundle and rescue patches remain locally under `~/cratis-ai-backup/` until all rescued work is safely merged.

## Work

- [ ] Open a GitHub Support request to purge obsolete pull-request refs and unreachable Planner/Ensemble objects from `Cratis/AI`.
- [ ] Record GitHub's response and the exact residual reachability.
- [ ] If Support cannot satisfy the requirement, decide whether to delete and recreate `Cratis/AI` after exporting/transferring remaining issues, settings, permissions, secrets, and workflow configuration.
- [ ] Verify all required Planner work exists in Stagehand and all Ensemble work exists in Ensemble before deleting recovery material.
- [ ] After acceptance, securely remove the history bundle, Stagehand patches, and temporary clones that contain the old history—or explicitly retain them as an approved exception.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The organization explicitly accepts either complete purge or documented residual GitHub PR retention.
- [ ] The chosen result is independently verified through GitHub API and `git ls-remote` checks.
- [ ] Recovery artifacts have a deliberate retention/deletion decision and owner.
- [ ] No required source or security change is lost.
title: Complete the approved Planner and Ensemble history purge
